name: Amazon

eyebrow.en: Amazon.com, Inc. · Common stock · Seattle, Washington
eyebrow.zh: 亚马逊 · 普通股 · 华盛顿州西雅图

title.en: AWS is back, and so is the capex.
title.zh: AWS 回来了，资本开支也来了。

lede.en: Amazon grew revenue 12% to $201.9B last quarter, about 16% without the Prime Day shift, and AWS accelerated to 39%, its fastest in nearly five years. Operating margin hit a record 13.9%. But Q3 capex of $77B pushed trailing free cash flow to −$42B, and 2027 spending will rise again.
lede.zh: 亚马逊上季营收增长 12% 至 2019 亿美元，剔除 Prime Day 移期约增 16%；AWS 增速加快至 39%，为近五年最快。营业利润率创纪录达 13.9%。但第三季 770 亿美元的资本开支使近12月自由现金流降至 −420 亿，2027 年支出还将上升。

s.zh: GAAP 历史 · 按 2027 年一致预期 EPS $10.69 约 23 倍
2026 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $196 to $287 over the past year; it closed at $243.79 before Q3 results and fell nearly 7% after hours.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $196 至 $287 间；第三季财报前收于 $243.79，盘后下跌近 7%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q2 2026 GAAP EPS of $5.75 includes a $53.4B pre-tax gain on Anthropic; Prime Day moved from Q3 to Q2 in 2026. Q4 is the holiday peak. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2026 年第二季 GAAP 每股 $5.75 含 534 亿美元 Anthropic 税前收益；2026 年 Prime Day 由第三季移至第二季。第四季为假日旺季。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +12% · 剔除 Prime Day 移期约 +16%

p.en: AWS grew 39.3%, a sixth straight quarter of acceleration, with a 38.7% margin and a $578B backlog. Jassy projects growth above 40% in both 2027 and 2028.
p.zh: AWS 增长 39.3%，连续第六个季度加速，利润率 38.7%，积压订单 5780 亿美元。贾西预计 2027 和 2028 年增速均超 40%。

p.en: The Trainium and Graviton chip business still grows at triple-digit rates, anchored by Anthropic; Amazon plans to sell Trainium to outside customers from late 2027.
p.zh: Trainium 与 Graviton 芯片业务仍以三位数增长，以 Anthropic 为支撑；亚马逊计划自 2027 年底起向外部客户出售 Trainium。

h.zh: 资本开支与自由现金流

p.en: Q3 capex of $77.3B was about $20B above estimates, and trailing free cash flow fell to −$42.4B from +$14.8B a year earlier. Jassy says 2027 spending will be meaningfully higher; long-term debt is $173B.
p.zh: 第三季资本开支 773 亿美元，比预期高约 200 亿；近12月自由现金流降至 −424 亿美元（一年前 +148 亿）。贾西称 2027 年支出将明显更高；长期债务 1730 亿美元。

p.en: Moving Prime Day into Q2 cut Q3 growth by about 4 points and ads grew only 12%. Management expects ad growth back in the high teens in Q4.
p.zh: Prime Day 移至第二季使第三季增速少约 4 个百分点，广告仅增 12%。管理层预计第四季广告增速回升至十几个百分点的高段。

p.en: The Anthropic markup inflated Q2 GAAP EPS to $5.75; it is not cash and can reverse, so trailing P/E looks lower than underlying profit.
p.zh: Anthropic 估值上调使第二季 GAAP 每股收益升至 $5.75；这不是现金，且可能反转，令历史市盈率低于实际盈利水平所示。

p.en: Guide: sales $240–247B (+12–16%), operating income $28.5–33.5B, ads growth in the high teens.
p.zh: 指引：营收 2400–2470 亿美元（+12–16%），营业利润 285–335 亿，广告增速十几个百分点高段。

p.en: Annual AWS conference in Las Vegas; usually brings new Trainium and AI service launches.
p.zh: 拉斯维加斯年度 AWS 大会，通常发布新 Trainium 与 AI 服务。

h.zh: 第四季业绩与 2027 资本开支

p.en: Date not yet announced; expected to quantify the 2027 capex increase.
p.zh: 日期未公布；预计量化 2027 年资本开支增幅。

sources: Price and 52-week range: daily closes; 2027 EPS consensus: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 30, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 30, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Amazon.com, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月30日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Amazon.com, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年9月30日 · 长期债务 1731 亿

read.en: Amazon's free cash flow is seasonal: weak or negative in the first half, strong in the holiday quarter. That pattern has broken in 2026: capex has climbed from $44B in Q1 to $77B in Q3, so even a record $42B of Q3 operating cash flow left −$35B, and the first nine months add up to −$62B.
read.zh: 亚马逊自由现金流有季节性：上半年弱或为负，假日季强。2026 年这一规律被打破：资本开支从第一季 440 亿升至第三季 770 亿，即使第三季经营现金流达 424 亿，自由现金流仍为 −350 亿，前九个月合计 −620 亿。

read.en: Amazon kept its ~$220B 2026 cash capex plan, which on paper leaves under $50B for Q4; given the Q3 pace I assume about $60B, roughly offset by holiday cash flow. Jassy says 2027 will be meaningfully higher, so I expect −$25B to −$40B a quarter in 2027: about −$95B over four quarters, funded by cash and new bonds.
read.zh: 亚马逊维持 2026 年约 2200 亿美元现金资本开支计划，账面上第四季不足 500 亿；按第三季节奏，我假设约 600 亿，与假日季现金流大致相抵。贾西称 2027 年将明显更高，因此我预计 2027 年每季 −250 亿至 −400 亿：四季合计约 −950 亿，以现金和新发债券弥补。

p.en: $77.3B of property and equipment purchases in Q3, about $20B above estimates, mostly AWS and AI; 2027 will be meaningfully higher.
p.zh: 第三季购置物业及设备 773 亿美元，比预期高约 200 亿，主要用于 AWS 与 AI；2027 年将明显更高。

p.en: Memory and other component prices have raised the cost of each unit of capacity.
p.zh: 内存等零部件涨价推高了单位产能成本。

p.en: Long-term debt reached $173.1B at Sep 30 after heavy issuance in 2026.
p.zh: 2026 年大量发债后，9月30日长期债务达 1731 亿美元。

bridgeNote.en: Before any new bonds; Amazon has issued debt regularly in 2026 and is likely to keep doing so.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新发债券；亚马逊 2026 年持续发债，预计还会继续。

extraNote.en: The Anthropic gain is a non-cash markup and does not affect cash flow.
extraNote.zh: Anthropic 收益为非现金估值上调，不影响现金流。

src: Q3 2026 release: cash flow and balance sheet
